purpose: Decide if source-transformed model baselines are actually detector-AI before spending paired A/B credits; not a prevalence estimate for all 27.
selection_rule: For each of six registered article clusters, take the first source-ordinal case with strict baseline fidelity admitted (T01,T06,T11,T16,T21,T26). Current A/B review outcomes played no role in choosing by ordinal; first T13 already measured AI/high is historical calibration, excluded from new prediction accuracy.

sample.rationale: Distinctive personal occurrence and attribution to jealousy may help, but however/then and neatly resolved childhood attachment inference are compact editorial signals.
First-person yurt childhood scene, odd Y2K comparison and mixed feelings unfold concretely rather than as a tidy generalized explanation.
Unusual first-person demon/loving-kindness encounter and concrete time course contrast with generic 'love more powerful than fear' synthesis; uncertain.
Repeated if/ask/start/once advisory sequence and neatly exhausted alternatives carry a compressed therapeutic instruction-manual cadence.
Particular third-person history turns into an ordinary first-person lived challenge ('my own hell'), though generalized master/love language is polished.
Four therapy terms distilled into a single question, case-conditioned timeline and standardized caveat; strong model-shaped informational cadence possible.

decision_after_reading: If baseline Human throughout, classify its pair as a source-rewrite quality/damage control; do not call A/B for that case. If baseline AI and both candidates faithfully preserve source, evaluate whether a paid A/B comparison would distinguish live competing hypotheses; freeze A/B forecasts before any paid calls. No automatic repeated POSTs for uncertain tasks or wrong versions.

billing.repeat_policy: none; content addressed cache plus task checkpoint
